findings.key_quote: Operating income $ 1,602 $ 1,293 Percentage of net sales Gross profit 21.1 % 21.1 % Operating expenses 17.8 % 18.1 % Operating income 4.6 % 4.3 %
findings.justification: For the three months ended April 30, 2026, Walmart International had operating income of $1,602 million with an operating margin of 4.6%, compared to 4.3% in the prior year. This shows the international business was profitable and improving its margin, contradicting the claim that it is a 'drag on overall profitability.' A drag would imply negative or deteriorating profitability.
